Ask a customer for several open invoices at once: one charge for the total, or one link they pay once. Credit on file is applied first, then the money is applied to the invoices in the business's order (`billing_rules_config.payment_application.invoice_order`; default oldest due first). `origin` says who asked: `manual` (operator or API), `dunning` (the clock's combined retry) or `portal` (the customer). Each invoice gets its own payment, so refunds and credit notes work per invoice.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/payment_requests`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-requests/create-a-payment-request) | Create a payment request |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_requests`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-requests/list-payment-requests) | List payment requests |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_requests/{preq}`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-requests/get-a-payment-request) | Get a payment request |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_requests/{preq}/cancel`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-requests/cancel-a-payment-request) | Cancel a payment request |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_requests/{preq}/charge`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-requests/charge-a-payment-request) | Charge a payment request |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_requests/{preq}/record_payment`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-requests/record-an-offline-payment-on-a-payment-request) | Record an offline payment on a payment request |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_requests/{preq}/send`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-requests/email-the-payment-request-link-again) | Email the payment request link again |
